title: Convert 1D Array Into 2D Array
summary: Given a 1D integer array and dimensions m and n, create an m x n 2D array by placing elements from the original array into rows sequentially, starting from index 0 to n-1 for the first row, then n to 2n-1 for the second row, and so forth.
statement: Given a 1D integer array and dimensions m and n, create an m x n 2D array by placing elements from the original array into rows sequentially, starting from index 0 to n-1 for the first row, then n to 2n-1 for the second row, and so forth. Return an empty 2D array if the original array's length does not match m times n.
constraints: m and n are positive and original has at most 50000 integers.
Fill an m-by-n matrix row by row without changing element order.
Return [] when len(original) is not m*n.
hints: A valid shape must contain exactly m*n cells.
After checking the size, take consecutive slices of width n.
The slices are disjoint, ordered, cover exactly m*n elements, and therefore implement row-major placement.
editorial: The slices are disjoint, ordered, cover exactly m*n elements, and therefore implement row-major placement.

tests.explanation: Two rows of width two produce [[1,2],[3,4]].
One row contains the original sequence unchanged.
